summary: Fence automatic idle suspend and wake admission at the owning store writer.

replay.detail: Existing runtime action receipts remain authoritative. Automatic requests, snapshot boundaries and evidence use the ordinary claim-operation identity and digest so reducers and generic retries see the same receipt. Automatic requests retain declaration, incarnation, policy epoch and wake-frontier provenance; separate idempotent eligibility and wake-demand evidence records explain admission decisions.

schema.detail: Adds optional idle provenance fields to runtime.action.requested and partial indexes for automatic and manual suspension episode candidates. No authoritative state is discarded.

rules.detail: Automatic admission requires signed idle_residency support from every active fleet member. The owner revalidates declaration, incarnation, policy epoch and caught-up demand frontiers under source-shard and graph-writer reservations. Mature demand or lag refusals are recorded once without consuming the eligible epoch. Wake admission prioritizes person demand, bounds concurrent owner-local wakes, excludes manual holds and retains durable capped retry timing. Missing or mismatched native sessions and invalid snapshots require intervention rather than automatic retry.

compatibility.detail: The daemon advertises idle_residency support. Automatic admission and evidence validate the existing signed fleet feature barrier in the same graph-writer transaction as publication; historical runtime actions remain readable.

downtime.detail: No downtime is required; source and graph reservations are limited to admission or last-reversible-boundary validation.

manual.detail: No operator override or migration is introduced. Manual suspension is not automatically resumed.

recovery.detail: Stable operation receipts deduplicate suspend epochs and wake attempts across processes and reopen. Wake readers subscribe to recipient mailbox changes even while empty or lagging, and to the pending message's receipt changes, so a suspended seat is woken reactively rather than waiting for a full reconciliation pass. Ranking reads for other seats do not add mailbox subscriptions; a seat with no wake demand skips queue scans and writer admission. With spare capacity, eligible waiters behind an unadmitted rival recheck within one second so a removed leader cannot strand them. Frontier-race aborts and source projection lag retain a bounded one-second retry with spare capacity, including for a seat that was selected for admission. The active-slot census finishes before deferring a lagged ranking, so full-capacity waiters follow runtime slot-release actions without polling. Failed native retries retain their durable backoff deadlines. Completed sleep episodes retain the first committed end timestamp across replay; failed or cancelled attempts do not create sleep episodes. Failed resume acceptance timestamps preserve retry deadlines; unavailable or lagging sources fail closed.
